message:
We all know that one friend who panics at the thought of a storm or unexpected event, right? 😅 Instead of adding to the anxiety, it can be really helpful to have a go-to resource for our little ones to understand and prepare for emergencies in a gentle way. The kids' preparedness section from Ready.gov offers fun and engaging tips to help them feel more secure and empowered. 

Taking a little time to explore this together can make a big difference in how we all handle surprises! What are some ways you help your kids feel prepared?
